findings.description: trade_with_cartographer is PASS_NO_OVERLAY in all 7 locked/op rows. The raw log shows a ~4 s server stall (17 ticks) during the interaction (cartographer offer generation), so the client post snapshot was taken around the denial; the denial itself is proven server-side (resync packets, TALKED_TO_VILLAGER +1, no MERCHANT menu). Overlay delivery for cartographer is unverified, not disproven.

The guard that fires in the locked rows is the native Villager.mobInteract offers.isEmpty wrap (offersEmpty -> entityDenied TRADE_WITH_*); no InventoryOpenEvent appears in any locked villager excerpt. E1 cites only the InventoryOpenEvent mapping (GameplayMenuAbilities) and the family resolver, so the exercised site is missing from the static map.

ATD_STAGE2A_STATE logs "TRADE_WITH_*": null: the probe does not report this ability's lock kind/required value, so the lock state is only implied by count < row threshold (cross-checked against the config files), not shown by the plugin. Denial itself is visible (overlay + no effect); observability gap, not a product defect.
